# CANDIDATE: BLOCK_OPTIONS_DELTA_SURGE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large SPY block options trades (>100 contracts) with extreme delta (>0.6 or <-0.6) reflect institutional directional bias that persists intraday. When aligned with a 50-period EMA break and elevated volume, these flows create a trend-following edge exploitable via SPY directional entries.

## Mechanism

Entry: Trigger long when FlowAlgo reports a block put/call trade >100 contracts with delta >0.6 and SPY crosses above its 50-period EMA on volume >2x 20-day average; trigger short for delta <-0.6 and cross below EMA. Exit: Close on 50-period EMA break, 2% adverse move from entry, or when a 1.5% trailing stop is hit (whichever occurs first). Regime filter: Only active during 0DTE expiry weeks; skip when VIX >30 or block trade size <50 contracts.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** Base simulation assumes qty=28 contracts (ITM-2 0DTE) requiring ~$25K account to risk 50% per trade; a $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L after scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** No historical sample yet; selection would rely on FlowAlgo block delta data (if available) – high overfit risk until Stage-1 backtest validates persistence.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward held-out window performed).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no realistic OPRA fill validation on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: adverse gap >2% on entry bar triggering stop; max drawdown: consecutive losing block signals during choppy regimes; blow-up scenario: volatility expansion causing repeated whipsaws and slippage exceeding edge.
6. **Concentration:** Unknown until backtest; will disclose top-5 days % of P&L after Stage-1 results.
